problems: The Khmer Empire row is two states: khmer-empire (802-1431) and the new post-angkor-cambodia (1432-1863); both list cliopatria_names ['Khmer Empire'] and each reviews only its own years. khmer-empire shows 13 'no verdict' warnings for the later shapes, which post-angkor-cambodia reviews (by design).

Overlap with se-01-h: Cliopatria's 'Cambodia' row (slug cambodia, 1700-1802, Q424, Wikipedia 'Cambodia Middle Period' = the Post-Angkor period article) is the Mekong delta that the Khmer shape loses in 1700 (287 of 295 cells). Decide whether `cambodia` is merged into post-angkor-cambodia as a second Cliopatria name or kept as delta land.

Cliopatria's Khmer shapes 1475-1699 carry 119-160 cells of the Champa 1429 shape (Bình Thuận, highlands); Bình Thuận is removed in post-angkor-cambodia, the highlands stay unverified; check against champa.json.

1864-1867: the Khmer row runs to 1867 but the protectorate starts 11 August 1863 and Cliopatria's French Indochina has no Cambodia until 1868; the french-indochina dossier (se-03) should carry the 1863 protectorate as vassal_start with counterpart post-angkor-cambodia; khmer-empire_1866 is marked wrong for that reason.

pagan-kingdom ends 17 December 1297 (Cliopatria 1293); the Myinsaing, Hanthawaddy and Shan States rows start 1294, so their dossiers should start 1297, 1287 and 1287. Matching events wanted elsewhere: yuan-dynasty gain of northern Burma 1284 (Zhengmian to 1303), hanthawaddy-kingdom 1287, shan-states 1287, myinsaing-kingdom 1297; ayutthaya-kingdom 1375 gain, 1353-1357 and 1393-1394 Angkor occupation/contest, 1594 Longvek, tribute from Cambodia to 1618; lan-xang 1363; sukhothai-kingdom 1238; champa 875 (its dossier has 757); nguyen-lords contest 1658-1699 and gain 1700; rattanakosin-kingdom 1795; nguyen-dynasty occupation 1834-1847.

Page budget: the Khmer row used its 9 pages across both Khmer dossiers (Khmer Empire, Khmer-Cham wars, Jayavarman II, Suryavarman I, Jayavarman VII, Sukhothai Kingdom, Post-Angkor period, Nam tien, French protectorate of Cambodia); Pagan used its 5 (one a disambiguation page). WebFetch returns a model's summary, so quotations are the summary's quotations of the page. sources_total counts distinct pages (the Khmer Empire page is listed in two dossiers).
